On VTES-L, seanmill wrote:
>
> I have some confusion about Kali's fang which states (2
> Aggravated Damage each strike...I believe). If an Assamite
> equiped with Kali's Fang attacked a vampire on which he had
> a contract and then played The Kabar Honor to do +3 hand
> damage what would be the results. Since Kali's fang doesn't
> say anything about hand damage do you only do the four point
> you would normally do with +3 hand damage, or do you do five
> points (two for the fang, three for Kabar Honor) and if you
> do five point of damage is it ALL aggravated or only the two
> from the Fang. Hope you all understand the question.

He strikes with his hands for +3 damage.

Kali's Fang, like all weapons, specifies an effect ("inflicts 2
aggravated damage" in the case of the Fang) that the minion
produces if he strikes with the weapon.

If the minion chooses a different strike (like "The Khabar:
Honor"), then he is not striking with the weapon, and the
weapon's effect doesn't apply to the strike.

If he chooses a strike that modifies the weapon strike (like
Lucky Blow: "use your... melee weapon..."), then the effect
of the weapon strike would still apply, of course.
